newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Supersol files U.S. draft prospectus.
newsitem.headline: Supersol files U.S. draft prospectus.

text.p: Israel's largest food retailer Supersol Ltd has filed a draft prospectus to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for a public offering, the company said in a statement to the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange (TASE) on Sunday.
Supersol said the prospectus was filed following the board of directors' decision in April to explore the possibility of raising capital through a public offering in the United States.
The statement said no final decision had been made about whether to conduct the offering, nor about its size or terms.

Tal Liani, chief analyst at Zannex Securities, said Supersol wanted to raise $100 million through an offering of American Depository Receipts (ADRs) before the end of the year. He said Supersol saw a U.S. listing as a way of raising its market value.
"The market values Blue Square Chain Stores Israel 20 percent more than Supersol because the company has a listing on Nasdaq," Liani said.
Blue Square is Supersol's leading competitor in the supermarket segment and floated shares in New York last July.

Liani added that the proceeds would probably be used by Supersol to finance its purchase of the Shekem supermarket chain, completed earlier this year, and meet its aim of opening 30 more stores in Israel by the year 2000, bringing the total to 150.
